name: Emily Foster
headline: Growth Marketing Specialist
summary: Results-driven Growth Marketing Specialist with 5 years of experience driving user acquisition, retention, and revenue growth through data-informed marketing strategies. Skilled in SEO, analytics, and experimentation frameworks, with a track record of optimising conversion funnels across B2C digital products.

responsibilities: Lead growth strategy across paid, organic, and lifecycle marketing channels
Design and execute A/B tests to optimise landing pages and improve conversion rates
Manage SEO strategy resulting in steady increase in organic traffic
Collaborate with product team to improve onboarding funnel using data insights
Report on KPIs to senior stakeholders using Google Analytics dashboards
Executed on-page and off-page SEO initiatives to improve search rankings
Ran A/B tests on email campaigns to improve open and click-through rates
Monitored website performance using Google Analytics and identified growth opportunities
Assisted in planning and executing paid social campaigns
Supported the marketing team with content creation and social media scheduling
Conducted keyword research to support SEO efforts
Compiled monthly performance reports using Google Analytics
